{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module JobWorker where

import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.IORef
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, void)
import Network.WebSockets (Connection, receiveData, sendTextData, runClient)
import Data.Aeson (decode, encode, Value(..), object, (.=), (.:))
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.FilePath (takeExtension, (</>))
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64

data WorkerConfig = WorkerConfig
  { wcEndpoint    :: T.Text
  , wcAuthToken   :: T.Text
  , wcOrigin      :: T.Text
  , wcMaxFileSize :: Int
  }

data JobMessage = JobMessage
  { jmId       :: T.Text
  , jmAction   :: T.Text
  , jmPayload  :: Value
  , jmOrigin   :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

data SessionState = SessionState
  { ssAuthenticated :: IORef Bool
  , ssOriginVerified :: IORef Bool
  , ssJobQueue :: MVar [JobMessage]
  }

parseJobMessage :: BL.ByteString -> Maybe JobMessage
parseJobMessage bs = do
  obj <- decode bs
  case obj of
    Object o -> do
      mid <- flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "id"
      action <- flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "action"
      payload <- flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "payload"
      origin <- flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "origin"
      return $ JobMessage mid action payload origin
    _ -> Nothing

verifyOrigin :: WorkerConfig -> T.Text -> Bool
verifyOrigin cfg origin = 
  let allowedOrigin = wcOrigin cfg
      -- Check if the origin matches our allowed origin
      -- Using isPrefixOf to handle subdomains
  in T.isPrefixOf allowedOrigin origin || origin == allowedOrigin

verifyAuthToken :: WorkerConfig -> T.Text -> Bool
verifyAuthToken cfg token = token == wcAuthToken cfg

authenticateSession :: WorkerConfig -> SessionState -> Value -> IO Bool
authenticateSession cfg state payload = do
  case payload of
    Object o -> do
      let mToken = flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "token"
      case mToken of
        Just token -> do
          let valid = verifyAuthToken cfg token
          writeIORef (ssAuthenticated state) valid
          return valid
        Nothing -> return False
    _ -> return False

processUpload :: WorkerConfig -> SessionState -> JobMessage -> IO (Either T.Text T.Text)
processUpload cfg state msg = do
  isAuth <- readIORef (ssAuthenticated state)
  unless isAuth $ error "Not authenticated"
  
  let originOk = verifyOrigin cfg (jmOrigin msg)
  writeIORef (ssOriginVerified state) originOk
  
  originVerified <- readIORef (ssOriginVerified state)
  if not originVerified
    then return $ Left "Origin verification failed"
    else do
      case jmPayload msg of
        Object o -> do
          let mFilename = flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "filename"
          let mContent = flip Aeson.parseMaybe o $ \v -> v .: "content"
          case (mFilename, mContent) of
            (Just fname, Just content) -> do
              let sanitizedName = sanitizeFilename fname
              let decoded = B64.decode (TE.encodeUtf8 content)
              case decoded of
                Right fileBytes -> do
                  if BS.length fileBytes > wcMaxFileSize cfg
                    then return $ Left "File too large"
                    else do
                      let fileHash = show (hash fileBytes :: Digest SHA256)
                      return $ Right (T.pack fileHash)
                Left err -> return $ Left (T.pack err)
            _ -> return $ Left "Missing filename or content"
        _ -> return $ Left "Invalid payload format"

sanitizeFilename :: T.Text -> T.Text
sanitizeFilename fname = 
  let base = last $ T.splitOn "/" fname
      clean = T.filter (\c -> c /= '.' || c == '.') base
  in if T.null clean then "unnamed" else clean

handleConnection :: WorkerConfig -> Connection -> IO ()
handleConnection cfg conn = do
  state <- SessionState
    <$> newIORef False
    <*> newIORef False
    <*> newMVar []
  
  forever $ do
    raw <- receiveData conn
    case parseJobMessage raw of
      Nothing -> sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["error" .= ("parse_error" :: T.Text)])
      Just msg -> do
        case jmAction msg of
          "auth" -> do
            ok <- authenticateSession cfg state (jmPayload msg)
            sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["authenticated" .= ok])
          "upload" -> do
            result <- processUpload cfg state msg
            case result of
              Right h -> sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["status" .= ("ok" :: T.Text), "hash" .= h])
              Left e -> sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["status" .= ("error" :: T.Text), "message" .= e])
          "status" -> do
            isAuth <- readIORef (ssAuthenticated state)
            sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["authenticated" .= isAuth])
          _ -> sendTextData conn (encode $ object ["error" .= ("unknown_action" :: T.Text)])

startWorker :: WorkerConfig -> IO ()
startWorker cfg = do
  let host = T.unpack $ wcEndpoint cfg
  runClient host 8080 "/jobs" (handleConnection cfg)
